items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: We lived in the 1500 block of North Claymore at that time, next to a bar room called Betty's Inn, where I first saw Louis Jordan and the Tempany Five on a Nickelodeon movie thing.

ctx.x: uh ever tell you how I got my first horn no no I was gonna that's one of my questions

yeah how you got it yeah I used to deliver the item newspaper in the evening and on the weekend I would deliver and try to sell the pitchboard courier in louisiana weekly and one week I saved up ten dollars and went to the j m music shop a pawn shop on rampart street and had this 35 dollar trumpet man well I only had ten dollars so I put the ten dollars on the trumpet and put it in a layaway and that was because weeks before that my mother wanted my father to uh sign a credit note or whatever it was from realize…

We lived in the 1500 block of North Claymore at that time, next to a bar room called Betty's Inn, where I first saw Louis Jordan and the Tempany Five on a Nickelodeon movie thing. You used to put the money in this machine, and it looked like a big television, you know, back in those days.
